description: Search the Nutrimeniu food database (Romanian and European foods, names in English and Romanian, diacritics optional) and return matching foods with their food_id, data source and nutrition values per 100 g (energy kJ/kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, protein, salt). Use this to look up a food by name, for example an ingredient that matched several foods or none in a nutrition calculation. Searches share a budget of 50 food lookups per conversation with incomplete calculations. Values are estimates from the source data, not laboratory analysis.

lang.description: Language of the query and of the returned names. Default en.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 20. Default 10.

query.description: Food name to look for, in English or Romanian (diacritics optional).

name: search_foods

limit_reached.description: Present only when a limit was reached: no search or calculation was made. message explains the limit; register_url, when present, opens the Nutrimeniu sign-up page.

title: Search foods
